뭔가 잘못됐다고 느껴질 때는 본능을 믿어라.
그는 그 충동적인 결정을 거의 즉시 후회했다.
그녀는 회의 중 휴대폰을 확인하고 싶은 충동을 참았다.
그는 천성적으로 명랑한 성향을 가지고 있다.
그 두 남매는 매우 다른 기질을 가지고 있다.
어떤 사람들은 불안에 대한 유전적 소인을 가지고 있다.
스트레스는 질병에 대한 취약성을 높일 수 있다.
그 실험은 만족을 지연시키는 아이들의 능력을 시험했다.
어떤 사람들은 다른 사람들보다 스트레스에 더 잘 대처한다.
초기의 성공은 그 팀에 위험한 안주함을 낳았다.
지도자들은 수년간의 안정 후에 안주하게 될 수 있다.
그 비판에 대한 그의 무관심은 동료들을 놀라게 했다.
유권자의 무기력은 그 정당의 주요 우려로 남아 있다.
많은 학생들이 그 과제에 대해 무기력해 보였다.
그 간호사는 그녀의 동정심 어린 보살핌으로 유명했다.
진화생물학자들은 오랫동안 이타주의의 기원을 두고 논쟁해왔다.
자원봉사를 하기로 한 그녀의 결정은 순전히 이타적이었다.
그는 불필요한 위험을 감수하는 성향이 있다.
많은 아이들은 어릴 때부터 채소에 대한 혐오감을 갖게 된다.
사소한 세부사항에 대한 그녀의 집착은 프로젝트 전체를 지연시켰다.
그 의사는 임상적인 초연함으로 진단 결과를 전달했다.
11: 그 리모델링은 건물의 원래 미학을 보존했다.
그 강좌는 현대 건축의 미학을 탐구한다.
그 갤러리는 전위적인 설치미술을 전문으로 한다.
그녀의 음악은 재즈와 포크를 절충적으로 혼합한다.
그 대성당의 천장은 화려하게 장식된 조각들로 뒤덮여 있다.
그 디자인은 장식적인 디테일보다 소박한 선을 선호한다.
그 아파트는 철저히 미니멀리스트 양식으로 꾸며져 있었다.
그 콘서트는 바로크 실내악 프로그램을 선보였다.
그 그림은 떠다니는 물체들의 초현실적인 풍경을 묘사한다.
그녀의 초기 작품은 구상적이었지만, 후에 추상화로 전향했다.
평론가는 그가 구상 조각으로 돌아온 것을 칭찬했다.
그 사진은 그 시대를 상징하는 이미지가 되었다.
종교적 도상학이 그 박물관의 중세 소장품을 지배한다.
새라는 반복되는 모티프가 그 소설 전반에 나타난다.
그 영화는 매우 다른 두 장르의 요소를 혼합한다.
그 회고전은 그 예술가의 작품 전체를 다룬다.
전문가들은 판매 전에 그 그림의 출처에 의문을 제기했다.
전문가들이 그 조각상의 진품성을 검증하기 위해 소집되었다.
그 갤러리는 위조품을 전시했다는 사실을 알고 당혹스러워했다.
그 조각상의 복제품이 이제 원본 자리에 서 있다.
그 작곡가는 부유한 후원자의 지원에 의존했다.
르네상스 미술은 왕실의 후원 아래 번성했다.
그는 고급 와인 감정가로 널리 알려져 있다.
그 젊은 피아니스트는 노련한 거장처럼 연주했다.
재즈는 능숙한 즉흥 연주에 크게 의존한다.
배우들은 장면이 잘못되었을 때 즉흥적으로 대처해야 했다.
그 소설의 주제는 오늘날에도 시대를 초월한 느낌을 준다.
12: 그 워크숍은 교수법에 대한 혁신적인 접근법을 소개한다.
그 교과서는 탄탄한 교육학적 틀을 반영한다.
그 대학은 더 많은 선택과목을 포함하도록 교육과정을 개정했다.
학생들은 수업에 참석하기 전에 입학 절차를 마쳐야 한다.
대학원 연구원들은 소박한 월 장학금을 받는다.
그녀는 박사 학위논문을 연구하는 데 2년을 보냈다.
그 대학은 표절에 대해 엄격한 처벌을 시행한다.
여러 학생이 에세이를 표절한 것이 적발되었다.
그 프로그램은 심사 후 인가를 잃었다.
그 기관은 국가 위원회로부터 인가를 받았다.
그녀는 민간 부문에서 일하기 위해 학계를 떠났다.
그 강의는 난해했지만 박식한 학자에 의해 진행되었다.
사소한 문법 실수에 대해 지나치게 까다롭게 굴지 마라.
일부 평론가들은 그 에세이가 지나치게 현학적이라고 여겼다.
그 발명가는 정규 교육 없이 대부분 독학한 사람이었다.
그 교수는 책을 완성하기 위해 안식년을 가졌다.
그녀가 종신 재직권을 얻는 데 10년이 걸렸다.
종신 재직권을 가진 교수진만이 그 위원회에 참여했다.
그 센터는 여러 학과에 걸친 학제간 연구를 지원한다.
그 대학은 여러 직종에 대한 직업 훈련을 제공한다.
디지털 문해력은 이제 필수적인 기술로 여겨진다.
그 프로그램은 성인들의 기초 수리력을 향상시키는 것을 목표로 한다.
그 옛 교육과정은 기계적 암기 학습에 크게 의존했다.
그 제도는 신입 직원을 선임 직원의 멘토링과 짝지어준다.
13: 그 개혁은 폭넓은 유권자층에게 호소할 것으로 예상된다.
참정권 운동은 투표권을 얻기까지 수십 년간 싸웠다.
정부는 헌법 개정에 대한 국민투표를 실시했다.
그 상원의원은 유권자들의 의견을 듣기 위해 타운홀 미팅을 열었다.
업계 단체들은 새 규제에 반대하며 강하게 로비했다.
극단적인 당파성은 타협을 점점 더 어렵게 만들었다.
그 법안은 보기 드문 초당적 지지로 통과되었다.
비평가들은 그 주가 새 선거구를 자의적으로 조정했다고 비난했다.
어떤 단일 정당도 연립 없이 통치할 만큼 충분한 의석을 얻지 못했다.
상원의원들은 표결을 지연시키기 위해 의사진행방해를 벌였다.
그 회의는 정족수 없이는 진행될 수 없었다.
그 정당 간부회의는 후보를 선정하기 위해 모였다.
그 법안은 이제 승인을 위해 주 입법부로 넘어간다.
권력은 행정부, 입법부, 사법부 사이에 분립되어 있다.
그 통치자는 공공 집회를 금지하는 법령을 공포했다.
분석가들은 그 지역 전역에 걸친 포퓰리즘의 부상을 지적한다.
그 포퓰리스트 후보는 기득권층에 도전하겠다고 약속했다.
기술관료 팀이 그 위기를 관리하기 위해 임명되었다.
비평가들은 그 체제를 소수 가문이 지배하는 과두정치라고 묘사한다.
그 장관은 조카를 채용한 후 정실인사라는 비난을 받았다.
정실주의는 임명 절차에 대한 대중의 신뢰를 훼손했다.
그 지역은 수년간의 협상 끝에 더 큰 자치권을 부여받았다.
그 나라는 수 세기 동안 신정정치로 통치되었다.
그 개혁은 이전에 배제되었던 수백만 시민에게 참정권을 부여했다.
14: 스마트폰은 현대 생활에서 어디에나 있는 존재가 되었다.
그 영화는 그 장르의 전형적인 예이다.
이사회는 그 제안에 대해 명백한 거부 의사를 밝혔다.
그녀는 지칠 줄 모르는 개혁 운동가로 남았다.
그 수다스러운 진행자는 손님들을 몇 시간 동안 즐겁게 했다.
그 보고서는 문제를 명확히 하기보다 애매하게 만들려는 의도로 보였다.
그 성명은 대중의 우려를 완화하는 데 거의 도움이 되지 않았다.
관계자들은 보상 약속으로 화난 주민들을 달래려 했다.
그 양보는 비평가들을 달래려는 시도로 여겨졌다.
관광객들은 그 택시 요금으로 터무니없는 가격을 청구받았다.
그 결혼식은 불필요하게 사치스럽다는 비판을 받았다.
투자하기 전에 돈을 좀 저축해두는 것이 신중할 것이다.
분석가들은 시장 상황을 고려할 때 그 합병이 경솔하다고 말했다.
그 판사는 양형에 있어 전적인 재량권을 부여받았다.
협상의 세부사항에 대해서는 신중을 기해 주세요.
그 회의에서 그녀의 부재는 눈에 띄었다.
그는 방 뒤편에서 눈에 띄지 않으려 애썼다.
편집자는 초고에서 여러 불필요한 단락을 삭제했다.
비평가들은 그 영화의 폭력성이 불필요하다고 여겼다.
많은 프리랜서들이 불안정한 재정 상황에 직면해 있다.
그 두 사건 사이의 연관성은 기껏해야 미약하다.
그 팬데믹은 세계 무역에 전례 없는 혼란을 일으켰다.
그 박물관은 비할 데 없는 고대 유물 컬렉션을 소장하고 있다.
그는 명성에도 불구하고 놀랍도록 잘난 체하지 않았다.
그 소문들은 전혀 근거가 없는 것으로 밝혀졌다.

1.title: 문법 1. 도치 강조구문 (Negative Inversion)
1.body:
**부정·제한 부사(구)가 문두에 오면 주어-동사 도치**

| 부사(구) | 의미 | 예 |
|----------|------|----|
| Never | 결코 ~않다 | **Never** had she seen such chaos. |
| Rarely/Seldom | 좀처럼 ~않다 | **Rarely** does the committee meet twice a month. |
| Not only... | ~뿐 아니라 | **Not only** did he resign, but he also apologized. |
| Little | 거의 ~않다 | **Little** did they know what awaited them. |
| No sooner...than | ~하자마자 | **No sooner** had she sat down **than** the phone rang. |
| Under no circumstances | 어떤 경우에도 ~않다 | **Under no circumstances** should you sign this. |

**도치 어순:** 부정부사 + 조동사/do + 주어 + 동사원형
practice: __________ (never) I seen such a compelling argument.
__________ (rarely) the board question the chairman's decisions.
No sooner __________ (the meeting begin) than the fire alarm went off.
__________ (under no circumstances) you should reveal the source.
1.answers: 1 Never have · 2 Rarely does · 3 had begun · 4 Under no circumstances should

1.title: 문법 2. 분열문 (Cleft Sentences)
1.body:
**It-cleft:** It is/was + 강조 요소 + that/who ...
> **It was** the manager **who** approved the budget.

**Wh-cleft (What-cleft):** What + S + V + is/was + 강조 요소
> **What** surprised everyone **was** his sudden resignation.

**All-cleft:** All + S + V + is/was + to부정사
> **All** she wants **is** to be heard.
practice: __________ (it, be) the data, not the theory, that changed his mind.
__________ (what, the report, reveal) was a pattern of neglect.
It was in 2019 __________ the policy first came into effect.
All he needed __________ (be) a little more time.
1.answers: 1 It was · 2 What the report revealed · 3 that · 4 was

1.title: 문법 3. 명사화 (Nominalization)
1.body:
**동사/형용사 → 명사** 전환으로 격식체 문장 완성

| 동사/형용사 | 명사형 | 예 |
|------------|--------|----|
| decide | decision | The committee's **decision** surprised everyone. |
| analyze | analysis | Further **analysis** is required. |
| assume | assumption | The **assumption** proved false. |
| significant | significance | The **significance** of the finding was clear. |
| aware | awareness | Public **awareness** has grown. |

**격식체 글쓰기에서는 동사절보다 명사구를 선호한다.**
practice: They decided to postpone the launch. → Their __________ to postpone the launch surprised investors.
The data were analyzed carefully. → Careful __________ of the data was essential.
He assumed that costs would fall. → His __________ that costs would fall proved false.
The public became aware of the risks. → Growing __________ of the risks changed public opinion.

2.title: 문법 1. 혼합 가정법 (Mixed Conditionals)
2.body:
**혼합가정법**: 조건절과 주절의 시제가 다른 경우

| 유형 | 형태 | 의미 |
|------|------|------|
| 과거 조건 → 현재 결과 | If + had p.p., would + 동사원형 | (과거에 ~했다면 지금 ~할 텐데) |
| 현재 조건 → 과거 결과 | If + 과거형, would have p.p. | (지금 ~라면 그때 ~했을 텐데) |

> **If** she **had studied** medicine, she **would be** a doctor now.
> **If** he **weren't** so stubborn, he **would have accepted** the offer.
practice: If they __________ (invest) earlier, the company would be far more profitable now.
If I __________ (be) you, I would have refused the offer.
She would be fluent in French now if she __________ (not quit) lessons years ago.
If he weren't so cautious, he __________ (take) the job already.
2.answers: 1 had invested · 2 were · 3 hadn't quit · 4 would have taken

2.title: 문법 2. 가정법 현재 (Present Subjunctive)
2.body:
**요구·제안·명령 동사 + that + S + (should) + 동사원형**

| 동사 | 예 |
|------|----|
| suggest, recommend | The doctor recommended (that) he **rest**. |
| demand, insist | They demanded (that) she **resign**. |
| require, propose | The rule requires (that) applicants **submit** proof. |

**formulaic subjunctive:** It is essential/vital/important that + S + 동사원형
> It is essential **that** every member **be** informed.
practice: The board insisted that the CEO __________ (step down) immediately.
It is vital that the report __________ (be) accurate.
The judge ordered that the documents __________ (remain) sealed.
The committee proposed that the meeting __________ (postpone).
2.answers: 1 step down · 2 be · 3 remain · 4 be postponed

2.title: 문법 3. 양보 구문 (albeit / notwithstanding)
2.body:
**양보를 나타내는 격식체 표현**

| 표현 | 품사 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| albeit | 접속사(구) | The plan succeeded, **albeit** slowly. |
| notwithstanding | 전치사/부사 | The project proceeded, objections **notwithstanding**. |
| even though | 접속사 (사실) | **Even though** it rained, the event continued. |
| even if | 접속사 (가정) | **Even if** it rains, the event will continue. |
| while/whereas | 접속사 (대조) | **Whereas** sales rose, profits fell. |
practice: The reform passed, __________ (albeit) after months of debate.
__________ the risks, the board approved the expansion. (notwithstanding 사용)
__________ he apologized, she refused to forgive him. (사실 양보)
__________ the deadline is moved, the scope will stay the same. (가정 양보)
2.answers: 1 albeit · 2 The risks notwithstanding · 3 Even though · 4 Even if

3.title: 문법 1. 복합 분사구문 (완료·수동 분사)
3.body:
**Having + p.p.**: 주절보다 먼저 일어난 일
> **Having finished** the report, she left early.

**Being + p.p. / p.p. (수동 분사구문)**
> (**Being**) **Written** in haste, the report contained several errors.

**부정형:** Not + 분사
> **Not having received** a reply, he called again.
practice: __________ (finish) the exam early, she reviewed her answers twice.
__________ (write) in the 1800s, the novel still feels relevant today.
__________ (not receive) any confirmation, they assumed the deal was off.
__________ (exhaust) by the journey, the team decided to rest.
3.answers: 1 Having finished · 2 Written · 3 Not having received · 4 Exhausted

3.title: 문법 2. 독립분사구문 (Absolute Construction)
3.body:
**주절과 주어가 다를 때 분사구문 앞에 의미상 주어를 남긴다**

> **The weather permitting**, we will hold the event outdoors.
> **All things considered**, the plan was a success.
> **Weather permitting** / **Everything else being equal** — 자주 쓰이는 관용 표현
practice: __________ (the deadline, approach), the team worked through the night.
All things __________ (consider), the merger was a wise decision.
__________ (there, be) no objections, the motion was passed.
__________ (weather, permit), the launch will proceed as planned.
3.answers: 1 The deadline approaching · 2 considered · 3 There being · 4 Weather permitting

3.title: 문법 3. 생략과 대용 (Ellipsis & Substitution)
3.body:
**반복되는 요소는 생략하거나 so/do so/one 등으로 대체**

| 대용 표현 | 용법 | 예 |
|-----------|------|----|
| so / not | think, hope, believe 뒤 | "Will it rain?" "I think **so**." |
| do so | 앞의 동사구 대체 | He asked her to leave, and she **did so**. |
| one(s) | 앞의 단수/복수 명사 대체 | I need a pen; do you have **one**? |
| (생략) | 반복되는 절 생략 | She can swim, and he can (swim), too. |
practice: "Is the project finished?" "I believe __________." (so 사용)
He was told to leave the room, and he __________ (do so) without protest.
I lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new __________ (대명사).
She wanted to resign, and eventually she __________ (반복 생략).

4.title: 문법 1. 조동사 + 완료 심화 (Modal Perfect)
4.body:
**조동사 + have + p.p.**: 과거 사실에 대한 추측·후회·불필요

| 표현 | 의미 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| must have p.p. | ~했음이 틀림없다 | She **must have left** already. |
| can't/couldn't have p.p. | ~했을 리 없다 | He **can't have said** that. |
| should have p.p. | ~했어야 했다(안 함) | You **should have called** first. |
| needn't have p.p. | ~할 필요 없었는데 했다 | You **needn't have worried**. |
| didn't need to | ~할 필요 없었다(중립) | We **didn't need to book** in advance. |

**needn't have vs didn't need to** 차이: needn't have는 "했지만 불필요했음", didn't need to는 단순 사실
practice: She __________ (must, leave) already; her coat is gone.
You __________ (needn't, worry) — the flight was delayed anyway.
He __________ (can't, forget) the meeting; he mentioned it yesterday.
We __________ (didn't need, bring) an umbrella since it never rained.
4.answers: 1 must have left · 2 needn't have worried · 3 can't have forgotten · 4 didn't need to bring

4.title: 문법 2. 수동 보고구문 (Passive Reporting Structures)
4.body:
**It is + p.p. + that절** / **S + is + p.p. + to부정사**

| 구조 | 예 |
|------|----|
| It is said/believed/reported that | **It is believed that** the CEO will resign. |
| S + is said/believed + to V | The CEO **is believed to** be resigning. |
| S + is said + to have p.p. | She **is said to have discovered** the error. |

**신문 기사·학술 글에서 출처를 밝히지 않고 전달할 때 사용**
practice: __________ (it, report) that talks have collapsed.
The suspect __________ (believe, flee) the country last week.
__________ (it, say) that the policy will be reversed.
The drug __________ (claim, reduce) symptoms significantly.
4.answers: 1 It is reported · 2 is believed to have fled · 3 It is said · 4 is claimed to reduce

4.title: 문법 3. 사역동사 심화 (Causative have/get)
4.body:
**have/get + O + p.p./원형/to V**

| 패턴 | 의미 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| have + O + p.p. | (남이) O를 ~하게 하다(당하다) | I **had** my car **repaired**. |
| get + O + p.p. | (더 구어체) | She **got** her hair **cut**. |
| have + O + 원형 | O가 직접 ~하게 시키다 | He **had** his assistant **book** the flight. |
| get + O + to V | O가 ~하도록 설득/유도 | They **got** him **to sign** the contract. |
practice: I need to __________ (have, my laptop, fix) before the trip.
She __________ (get, her son, clean) his room every Saturday.
The manager __________ (have, the intern, prepare) the slides.
It took some effort to __________ (get, them, agree) to the new terms.
4.answers: 1 have my laptop fixed · 2 gets her son to clean · 3 had the intern prepare · 4 get them to agree

5.title: 문법 1. 전치사 관계절 (whereby / wherein)
5.body:
**whereby = by which, wherein = in which** (격식체 관계부사)

| 표현 | 의미 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| whereby | 그것에 의하여 | a system **whereby** citizens vote online |
| wherein | 그 안에서 | a report **wherein** the flaws are detailed |
| whereupon | 그러자, 그 후에 | He apologized, **whereupon** she relented. |

**whereby/wherein은 사물 선행사 + 전치사+관계대명사 결합 형태**
practice: They devised a scheme __________ profits are shared equally.
The contract contains a clause __________ either party may withdraw.
He revealed the truth, __________ the room fell silent.
This is the process __________ raw data becomes usable information.

5.title: 문법 2. 강조 도치 (so...that / 강조 do)
5.body:
**So + 형용사/부사 + that절 도치**
> **So severe was the damage that** the building had to be demolished.

**Such + be동사 + that절 도치**
> **Such was her influence that** no one dared object.

**강조 do/does/did + 동사원형**
> She **does** understand the risks. / He **did** warn us.
practice: __________ (so, great, be) the demand that the store sold out in an hour.
__________ (such, be) his reputation that clients came from abroad.
I know it seems unlikely, but she __________ (강조, pass) the exam.
He claims he never received the email, but we __________ (강조, send) it twice.
5.answers: 1 So great was · 2 Such was · 3 does · did · 4 did send

5.title: 문법 3. the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 … (Double Comparatives)
5.body:
**the + 비교급 ~, the + 비교급 …**: ~할수록 더 …하다

> **The more** carefully you plan, **the fewer** mistakes you make.
> **The longer** the delay, **the higher** the cost.
> **The sooner** we start, **the sooner** we finish.
practice: __________ you practice, __________ you become. (더 많이 연습할수록 더 능숙해진다)
__________ the risk, __________ the potential reward.
__________ people join, __________ the event becomes.
__________ she explained, __________ confused he got.
5.answers: 1 The more / the more skilled · 2 The greater / the greater · 3 The more / the more lively · 4 The more / the more

6.title: 문법 1. 담화표지 (hence / thereby / whereas)
6.body:
**격식체 접속 부사**

| 표현 | 의미 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| hence | 그러므로 | Costs rose; **hence**, prices increased. |
| thereby | 그렇게 함으로써 | He resigned, **thereby** avoiding a vote. |
| whereas | 반면에 | Sales rose, **whereas** profits fell. |
| thus | 따라서 | The data were flawed, **thus** invalid. |
| in that | ~라는 점에서 | The plan is risky **in that** it relies on one supplier. |
practice: Demand fell sharply; __________, production was cut.
She signed the agreement, __________ committing the firm to new terms.
The north saw growth, __________ the south experienced decline.
The proposal is unusual __________ it challenges standard practice.

6.title: 문법 2. 완곡 표현 (Hedging Language)
6.body:
**단정을 피하고 가능성을 나타내는 표현**

| 표현 | 예 |
|------|----|
| seem to / appear to | The theory **seems to** hold in most cases. |
| tend to | Younger investors **tend to** take more risks. |
| arguably | This is **arguably** the most important finding. |
| it could be argued that | **It could be argued that** the policy failed. |
| to some extent | The claim is, **to some extent**, justified. |
practice: The results __________ (seem) to support the hypothesis.
Smaller firms __________ (tend) to adapt more quickly.
__________, this is the most significant reform in decades. (arguably)
__________ that the reform came too late. (it could be argued)
6.answers: 1 seem · 2 tend · 3 Arguably · 4 It could be argued

6.title: 문법 3. 전치사 연어 (Formal Preposition Collocations)
6.body:
**격식체에서 자주 쓰이는 전치사 연어**

| 표현 | 예 |
|------|----|
| in light of | **In light of** the evidence, the policy was revised. |
| with regard to | Little is known **with regard to** long-term effects. |
| in accordance with | The action was taken **in accordance with** the law. |
| at the expense of | Growth came **at the expense of** the environment. |
| on the grounds that | The appeal was rejected **on the grounds that** it lacked evidence. |
practice: __________ the new data, the committee revised its forecast.
The report says little __________ implementation costs.
The permit was issued __________ local regulations.
Efficiency was achieved __________ quality.
6.answers: 1 In light of · 2 with regard to · 3 in accordance with · 4 at the expense of

7.title: 문법 1. 화법 심화 (Reported Speech Nuance)
7.body:
**시제 일치의 예외:** 불변의 진리·현재도 유효한 사실은 시제 유지
> She said the Earth **revolves** around the Sun.
> He mentioned that he **is** moving to Berlin next month.

**보고동사 + 목적어 + to V / -ing / that절**

| 동사 | 패턴 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| insist on | -ing | He **insisted on paying** the bill. |
| deny | -ing | She **denied taking** the file. |
| accuse A of | -ing | They **accused him of lying**. |
| warn A not to | to V | She **warned them not to leave**. |
| urge A to | to V | He **urged the board to reconsider**. |
practice: He said that water __________ (boil) at 100°C.
She denied __________ (take) the missing files.
They accused the firm __________ (mislead) investors.
The officer warned drivers __________ (not, exceed) the speed limit.
7.answers: 1 boils · 2 taking · 3 of misleading · 4 not to exceed

7.title: 문법 2. 격식체 구동사 (Formal Phrasal Verbs)
7.body:
**구어체 구동사 → 격식체 단어(글쓰기에서 선호)**

| 구동사 | 격식체 동의어 | 예 |
|--------|---------------|----|
| put off | postpone | The meeting was **postponed**. |
| bring about | cause | The policy **brought about/caused** major change. |
| come across | encounter | Researchers **came across/encountered** an anomaly. |
| go on with | continue | The talks **continued/went on**. |
| put up with | tolerate | Residents **tolerated/put up with** the noise. |
| look into | investigate | Officials **investigated/looked into** the claim. |
practice: The launch was __________ (put off) due to technical issues.
Rapid urbanization __________ (bring about) significant environmental change.
During the audit, they __________ (come across) several discrepancies.
The agency agreed to __________ (look into) the complaint.
7.answers: 1 put off · 2 brought about · 3 came across · 4 look into

7.title: 문법 3. 관용표현 (Formal Idiomatic Expressions)
7.body:
**시험·에세이에 자주 쓰이는 관용 표현**

| 표현 | 의미 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| in the wake of | ~의 여파로 | Reforms followed **in the wake of** the scandal. |
| by and large | 대체로 | **By and large**, the policy has succeeded. |
| a far cry from | ~와는 거리가 먼 | The result was **a far cry from** expectations. |
| to all intents and purposes | 사실상 | The project is, **to all intents and purposes**, complete. |
| at the crux of | ~의 핵심에 | Trust is **at the crux of** the negotiation. |
practice: __________ the crisis, new regulations were introduced.
__________, the reforms have been well received.
The outcome was __________ what analysts had predicted.
__________, the deal is finalized.
7.answers: 1 In the wake of · 2 By and large · 3 a far cry from · 4 To all intents and purposes

8.title: 문법 1. 고급 수동태 (get-passive / 이중수동)
8.body:
**get-passive:** 구어체·상태 변화 강조
> He **got promoted** last month.

**이중수동 (double passive):** to부정사 수동 뒤에 또 다른 수동
> The suspect **is expected to be charged** tomorrow.
> The proposal **is believed to have been rejected**.

**감정/피해 강조 get-passive:** get hurt, get caught, get fired
practice: He __________ (get, fire) after the scandal broke.
The bill __________ (expect, pass) next week.
She __________ (get, promote) to senior manager last spring.
The documents __________ (believe, have, destroy) before the audit.
8.answers: 1 got fired · 2 is expected to be passed · 3 got promoted · 4 are believed to have been destroyed

8.title: 문법 2. 전치 강조 (Fronting for Emphasis)
8.body:
**목적어·보어를 문두로 이동해 강조**

> **Such** was the confusion **that** no one knew who was in charge.
> **A good leader** she certainly is.
> **Never before** had the team faced such pressure.
practice: __________ (a remarkable teacher) he was, everyone agreed.
__________ (such, be) the pressure that she nearly quit.
__________ (never before) had the region seen such rainfall.
__________ (this, argument) I simply cannot accept.
8.answers: 1 A remarkable teacher · 2 Such was · 3 Never before · 4 This argument

8.title: 문법 3. 병렬구조 (Parallel Structure)
8.body:
**등위접속사·상관접속사로 연결된 요소는 문법적으로 동일한 형태**

> The plan is **cost-effective, efficient, and sustainable**.
> She enjoys **reading, writing, and editing**.
> **Not only** did he apologize **but also** offered compensation.

**흔한 오류:** to부정사와 동명사를 섞어 쓰는 것
practice: The report is thorough, concise, and __________ (persuade).
She likes hiking, swimming, and __________ (cycle).
He not only missed the deadline but also __________ (fail) to notify anyone.
The goal is to reduce costs and __________ (improve) efficiency.

9.title: 문법 1. 미래시제 뉘앙스 (be to / be about to)
9.body:
**공식적·예정된 미래**

| 표현 | 뉘앙스 | 예 |
|------|--------|----|
| be to V | 공식 일정, 규정 | The president **is to visit** Berlin next week. |
| be about to V | 임박한 미래 | The plane **is about to depart**. |
| be on the point of -ing | 막 ~하려던 참 | She **was on the point of leaving** when he called. |
| be due to V | 예정되어 있다 | The report **is due to** be published Friday. |
practice: The minister __________ (be, to, announce) the results tomorrow morning.
The train __________ (be, about, leave) — hurry!
She __________ (be, on the point of, resign) when they offered a raise.
The results __________ (be, due to) come out next Monday.
9.answers: 1 is to announce · 2 is about to leave · 3 was on the point of resigning · 4 are due to

9.title: 문법 2. 완료진행 심화 (Perfect Progressive Nuance)
9.body:
**현재완료진행 vs 과거완료진행: 지속과 그 결과**

> She **has been researching** the topic for three years.
> By the time he arrived, we **had been waiting** for two hours.

**미래완료진행:** will have been -ing
> By June, she **will have been working** here for a decade.
practice: They __________ (negotiate) for six hours by the time the deal was reached.
By next year, he __________ (teach) at the university for twenty years.
She __________ (already, work) there for a year when the merger happened.
We __________ (wait) for over an hour when the bus finally arrived.
9.answers: 1 had been negotiating · 2 will have been teaching · 3 had already been working · 4 had been waiting

9.title: 문법 3. 시간절 심화 (Time Clause Nuance)
9.body:
**시간 접속사 뉘앙스**

| 접속사 | 의미 | 예 |
|--------|------|----|
| once | 일단 ~하면 | **Once** approved, the plan cannot be changed. |
| as soon as | ~하자마자 | She called **as soon as** she landed. |
| by the time | ~할 때쯤이면 | **By the time** you read this, I'll be gone. |
| the moment (that) | ~하는 순간 | **The moment** the doors opened, crowds rushed in. |

**시간 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재시제 사용**
practice: __________ (once) the contract is signed, no changes can be made.
She will call you the moment she __________ (arrive).
By the time the show starts, most seats __________ (already, fill).
__________ (as soon as) the results are announced, shares are expected to rise.
9.answers: 1 Once · 2 arrives · 3 will already have filled · 4 As soon as

10.title: 문법 1. 한정사·수량사 심화 (a number of vs the number of)
10.body:
**a number of vs the number of**

| 표현 | 의미 | 수 일치 | 예 |
|------|------|---------|----|
| a number of + 복수명사 | 많은 (수량) | 복수 동사 | **A number of** students **were** absent. |
| the number of + 복수명사 | ~의 수(그 자체) | 단수 동사 | **The number of** applicants **has** risen. |
| a great deal of | 많은 (불가산) | 단수 동사 | **A great deal of** effort **was** required. |
| quite a few | 상당히 많은 | 복수 동사 | **Quite a few** issues **remain**. |
practice: A number of proposals __________ (be) rejected outright.
The number of complaints __________ (have) doubled this year.
A great deal of research __________ (support) this conclusion.
Quite a few employees __________ (express) concern about the change.

10.title: 문법 2. 관사 고급 (Advanced Article Usage)
10.body:
**총칭·추상 표현에서의 관사**

| 용법 | 예 |
|------|----|
| the + 형용사 = ~한 사람들 | **the poor**, **the elderly**, **the unemployed** |
| the + 단수명사 = 종 전체 | **The whale** is a mammal. |
| 무관사 추상명사 | **Justice** must prevail. (일반 개념) |
| the + 추상명사 (특정) | **The justice** of the ruling was questioned. (특정 사례) |
practice: __________ (the, elderly) often require additional social support.
__________ (the, computer) has transformed modern communication.
__________ (justice) is a universal ideal.
__________ (the, silence) in the room was unbearable.
10.answers: 1 The elderly · 2 The computer · 3 Justice · 4 The silence

10.title: 문법 3. 가산/불가산 뉘앙스
10.body:
**같은 단어라도 가산/불가산에 따라 의미가 달라짐**

| 단어 | 불가산 | 가산 |
|------|--------|------|
| paper | 종이 | a paper = 논문 |
| experience | 경험(전반) | an experience = 특정 경험 |
| light | 빛 | a light = 조명기구 |
| room | 공간, 여지 | a room = 방 |
| time | 시간(전반) | a time = 특정 시기/횟수 |
practice: She wrote __________ (a paper) on climate migration.
Working abroad was __________ (an experience) she never forgot.
There isn't much __________ (room) left in the schedule.
We visited the museum several __________ (time) last year.
10.answers: 1 a paper · 2 an experience · 3 room · 4 times

11.title: 문법 1. 접속부사 (nonetheless / notwithstanding)
11.body:
**문장 간 연결하는 격식체 부사**

| 표현 | 의미 | 예 |
|------|------|----|
| nonetheless/nevertheless | 그럼에도 불구하고 | The risks were high; **nonetheless**, they proceeded. |
| notwithstanding | ~에도 불구하고(전치사) | **Notwithstanding** the risks, they proceeded. |
| that said | 그렇긴 하지만 | It's expensive. **That said**, it works well. |
| conversely | 반대로 | Prices rose in the north; **conversely**, they fell in the south. |
practice: The evidence was weak; __________, the jury convicted.
__________ the objections, the board approved the merger.
The product is costly. __________, it has sold well.
Urban areas saw growth; __________, rural areas declined.

11.title: 문법 2. 양보·대조절 심화
11.body:
**양보(인정) vs 대조(단순 차이) 구분**

| 접속사 | 기능 | 예 |
|--------|------|----|
| although/even though | 양보 (인정하지만) | **Although** it rained, we went out. |
| whereas/while | 대조 (단순 비교) | Sales rose, **whereas** costs fell. |
| however + 형용사/부사 | 아무리 ~해도 | **However** difficult it seems, we must try. |
| much as | ~이긴 하지만 | **Much as** I admire him, I disagree here. |
practice: __________ he apologized repeatedly, she remained upset.
City incomes rose, __________ rural incomes stagnated.
__________ hard the task may be, giving up isn't an option.
__________ I respect her opinion, I can't agree this time.

11.title: 문법 3. 복문 결합 (Combining Clauses)
11.body:
**여러 절을 하나의 복문으로 결합하는 전략**

> Because the data were incomplete, and because time was short, the team postponed the study.
> → **Given that** the data were incomplete and time was short, the team postponed the study.

**Given that / Considering that / In view of the fact that** = ~을 고려할 때
practice: __________ (given that) the budget is limited, the scope must be reduced.
__________ (considering that) she is new, her performance is impressive.
__________ (in view of the fact that) profits fell, layoffs were announced.
Combine: The plan is bold. It is risky. → The plan is __________ bold __________ risky.
11.answers: 1 Given that · 2 Considering that · 3 In view of the fact that · 4 both / and

12.title: 문법 1. 동사 패턴 의미차 (stop to do vs stop doing)
12.body:
**to부정사 vs 동명사: 의미가 달라지는 동사**

| 동사 | + to V | + -ing |
|------|--------|--------|
| stop | 하기 위해 멈추다 | ~하는 것을 그만두다 |
| remember | ~할 것을 기억하다(미래) | ~했던 것을 기억하다(과거) |
| forget | ~할 것을 잊다 | ~했던 것을 잊다 |
| try | 시도하다(노력) | 시험 삼아 해보다 |
| regret | ~하게 되어 유감이다 | ~한 것을 후회하다 |
practice: He stopped __________ (smoke) five years ago.
She stopped __________ (check) her phone during the meeting.
I remember __________ (lock) the door before we left.
We regret __________ (inform) you that your application was unsuccessful.
12.answers: 1 smoking · 2 to check · 3 locking · 4 to inform

12.title: 문법 2. 형용사+전치사 연어
12.body:
**형용사 + 전치사 고정 결합**

| 형용사 | 전치사 | 예 |
|--------|--------|----|
| skeptical | of/about | She is **skeptical of** the claim. |
| indifferent | to | He seemed **indifferent to** the outcome. |
| conducive | to | A quiet room is **conducive to** studying. |
| synonymous | with | Success became **synonymous with** hard work. |
| oblivious | to | He was **oblivious to** the danger. |
practice: Many economists remain skeptical __________ the forecast.
The manager seemed indifferent __________ staff concerns.
A calm environment is conducive __________ concentration.
He was completely oblivious __________ the risks involved.

12.title: 문법 3. 동사+전치사 연어
12.body:
**동사 + 전치사 고정 결합**

| 동사 | 전치사 | 예 |
|------|--------|----|
| account for | ~을 설명하다/차지하다 | Exports **account for** half of GDP. |
| dispose of | ~을 처분하다 | The firm **disposed of** its old equipment. |
| refrain from | ~을 삼가다 | Please **refrain from** smoking. |
| embark on | ~에 착수하다 | The company **embarked on** a new venture. |
| capitalize on | ~을 활용하다 | Investors **capitalized on** the price drop. |
practice: Rising fuel costs account __________ much of the price increase.
The company disposed __________ its outdated machinery.
Please refrain __________ using phones during the ceremony.
The startup embarked __________ an ambitious expansion plan.

13.title: 문법 1. 부가의문·간접의문 격식체
13.body:
**격식체 부가의문 및 간접의문**

> You **wouldn't** happen to know the answer, **would you**?
> I wonder **whether** the proposal will be approved.
> Could you tell me **what time the meeting starts**?

**간접의문 어순: 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 (도치 없음)**
practice: Could you tell me __________ (where, the office, be)?
I wonder __________ (whether, they, agree) to the terms.
You haven't seen my keys, __________?
Do you know __________ (why, the flight, be delay)?
13.answers: 1 where the office is · 2 whether they will agree · 3 have you · 4 why the flight was delayed

13.title: 문법 2. what/all 강조구문
13.body:
**What절/All절을 이용한 강조**

> **What** the company needs **is** stronger leadership.
> **All** that matters **is** the final result.
> **What** worries investors most **is** the lack of transparency.
practice: __________ (what, the team, need) is more time.
__________ (all, she, want) is a fair hearing.
__________ (what, surprise, everyone) was the sudden announcement.
__________ (all, that, matter) now is customer satisfaction.
13.answers: 1 What the team needs · 2 All she wants · 3 What surprised everyone · 4 All that matters

13.title: 문법 3. 부정어 도치 심화 (Only + 부사절)
13.body:
**Only + 부사(구)/절 도치**

> **Only after the trial** did the truth emerge.
> **Only when** prices fell **did** demand recover.
> **Not until** she apologized **did** he respond.

**Not until = ~하고 나서야 비로소**
practice: __________ (only after, the audit) did the fraud come to light.
__________ (only when, costs fall) will demand increase.
__________ (not until, she explain) did the misunderstanding end.
__________ (only then, they, realize) their mistake.
13.answers: 1 Only after the audit · 2 Only when costs fall · 3 Not until she explained · 4 Only then did they realize

14.title: 문법 1. 격식/비격식 전환 (Register Transformation)
14.body:
**같은 의미, 다른 격식 수준**

| 비격식 | 격식 |
|--------|------|
| find out | ascertain / determine |
| a lot of | a great deal of / numerous |
| get better | improve |
| because of | owing to / due to |
| but | however / nevertheless |

**CAE Reading & Use of English Part 4(문장 바꿔쓰기)의 핵심 전략**
practice: We need to find out why sales dropped. → We need to __________ why sales dropped.
A lot of people attended the event. → __________ people attended the event.
The economy got better after the reform. → The economy __________ after the reform.
The flight was delayed because of the storm. → The flight was delayed __________ the storm.
14.answers: 1 ascertain/determine · 2 A great deal of / Numerous · 3 improved · 4 owing to/due to

14.title: 문법 2. 요약문 작성법 (Summary Writing)
14.body:
**요약 작성 원칙**

1. 핵심 논지만 남기고 예시·부연은 제외
2. 원문 표현을 자신의 말로 바꿔쓰기 (paraphrase)
3. 한 문장 안에 여러 내용을 압축 (분사구문, 관계절 활용)
4. 지나치게 긴 인용 대신 요약된 명사구 사용

> 원문: "The company faced financial difficulties, so it decided to lay off a third of its staff."
> 요약: **Facing financial difficulties, the company cut a third of its workforce.**
practice: 원문: The rules were unclear, so many people broke them unintentionally. → 요약: __________ unclear, many broke them unintentionally.
원문: She was tired, but she kept working. → 요약: __________ tired, she kept working.
원문: The report is long. It covers ten topics. → 요약: The __________ report covers ten topics.
핵심만 남기기: 'The committee met for three hours and eventually, after much debate, approved the plan.' → __________ approved the plan after lengthy debate.
14.answers: 1 Being · 2 Despite being · 3 lengthy/lengthy ten-topic · 4 The committee

14.title: 문법 3. 14일 고난도 종합
practice: [도치] __________ had the results been announced when shares surged.
[분열문] __________ the CEO's resignation that shocked investors most.
[혼합가정] If the board __________ (act) sooner, the crisis would be over by now.
[수동보고] The merger __________ (believe, finalize) by next quarter.
[전치사관계절] This is the mechanism __________ funds are redistributed.
[영작] 그 정책은 논란의 여지가 있지만, 결국 시행되었다. (albeit 사용)
[영작] 그녀가 사임하고 나서야 진실이 드러났다. (Not until 도치)
[요약] 'Because the evidence was inconclusive, the case was dropped.' → __________ evidence, the case was dropped.
14.answers: 1 No sooner · 2 It was · 3 had acted · 4 is believed to be finalized · 5 whereby · 6 The policy was controversial, albeit eventually implemented. · 7 Not until she resigned did the truth emerge. · 8 Given the inconclusive
